title: Org policy hub - granular export & IP control switches
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Customers operating under strict compliance regimes need a single, discoverable place to configure organization-wide compliance decisions that affect networking (IP allowlists), data egress (export/downloads, public sharing), and authentication enforcement (SSO/SAML required). Current controls are scattered between Console 'Security' pages, API flags, and per-project toggles, causing blind spots in audit trails and inconsistent enforcement across Hosted/Dedicated/Private deployments.

Goal: Implement an 'Org Policy Hub' that centralizes admin controls for: (1) IP allowlisting with CIDR/range rules and per-region overrides, (2) disable public sharing (file/URL/embedding exports), (3) restrict data exports (CSV/JSON/downloads/embeddings), and (4) an enforcement toggle that requires SSO/SAML for all org users. All changes must be recorded in audit logs, surfaced in Console, and available via the Admin API. This ticket scopes the backend enforcement, audit trace, and API surface; separate UX ticket will own Console polish.
acceptance_criteria: 1) PUT/POST Admin API endpoints to set org-level flags for ip_allowlist, block_public_sharing, and export_policy exist and return 200 on valid inputs; 2) RBAC v2: only users with 'org:admin' permission can mutate these flags; 3) Enforcement layer checks flags on request paths that lead to data egress (download/export/embedding export/public-share) and returns 403 when blocked; 4) All flag changes and enforcement denials emit structured audit events with: actor, timestamp, before/after, target_resource, request_id; 5) Audit events are queryable in Console and exported to customer Kinesis/Syslog webhook where configured; 6) SAML enforcement toggles cause sign-in flow to reject non-SSO sessions for protected orgs and are enforced on token minting endpoints; 7) Automated tests and e2e QA covering Hosted and Dedicated modes pass.
implementation_plan:
Phase 1 (backend): Add Admin API endpoints (/v1/admin/orgs/{org}/policy) + schema validation for policies. Persist in org config store (Postgres + JSONB) and surface to cache layer (redis) for low-latency enforcement. Phase 2 (enforcement): Add policy check middleware on export/download/embeddings routes and on token minting endpoint used by SSO flows. Phase 3 (audit): Hook policy mutations and enforcement denials into audit event pipeline; add structured fields for SIEM. Phase 4 (integration): Wire RBAC v2 permission checks and sample migration script to reconcile legacy toggles. Phase 5 (QA + rollout): Canary in staging, limited rollouts to Private customers with migration window, then org-wide release.

Approximate tasks: DB migration, Admin API handlers, middleware hooks, audit producer changes, RBAC policy changes, unit+integration tests, docs + runbook update.
technical_notes:
- Use existing org_config table; add 'policies' JSONB column schema: {"ip_allowlist": [{"cidr":"10.0.0.0/8","description":"internal"}], "block_public_sharing": true, "export_policy": "restricted"}.
- Cache TTL 30s and pub/sub invalidation on writes.
- Enforcement middleware must consult cache first; fall back to DB on cache miss.
- Audit events follow existing schema (audit_type: POLICY_CHANGE / EXPORT_DENIED) and must include request_id.
- SAML enforcement: validate at token mint step to avoid session drift (reject refresh tokens if org requires SSO and session is non-SSO).
- For Dedicated/Private: support an 'airgap_mode' flag where audit exports are written to a local file path or syslog instead of external SaaS.
qa_test_plan:
- Unit tests for Admin API validation (CIDR validation, schema errors).
- Integration tests: simulate export requests with and without allowed IPs checking enforcement returns 200/403.
- SSO tests: ensure session created via password flow is blocked when SSO required; ensure valid SAML session passes.
- E2E: deploy to staging, flip flags via Admin API, run a sample app to attempt public share and embedding export.
- Load test: measure additional latency on export path with middleware (~should be <2ms median).
rollout_plan:
1) Feature-flagged rollout behind 'org_policy_hub' runtime flag. 2) Release to internal staging, run compliance smoke tests. 3) Canary to 5% of Hosted orgs; monitor audit event rate, 403 spike, and support tickets. 4) Offer migration helper to reconcile legacy toggles and schedule Dedicated/Private customers with Solutions Eng. 5) GA after 4 weeks of stable telemetry.

Support runbook: steps to revert policy or disable enforcement via emergency endpoint; contact list: Security on-call, Platform on-call, SRE.
risks_and_mitigations:
- Risk: Misconfigured CIDR blocks may lock admins out. Mitigation: require a 'bypass key' bootstrap token on initial write and send confirmation email to org owners; provide console warning and strict validation.
- Risk: Audit pipeline overload with verbose events. Mitigation: batch audit exports and add sampling for high-frequency non-critical events.
- Risk: Behavioral divergence in Dedicated/Private. Mitigation: add 'deployment_mode' aware handlers and test matrices for each deployment type.
